purpose: Independent pass/fail criteria for the first CPU desktop framebuffer capture, derived from the frozen client and compositor sources before the frame was seen.

sources.client: integrations/puredarwin/chonkstep-darwin/client/src/main.rs (W=800, H=480; paint loop lines 112-123; glyph table)
sources.decoder: m1n1 pixel2rgb_30 (R=p>>22, G=p>>12, B=p>>2, &255), as in tools/render_boot_framebuffer.py

criteria.C1_fresh_capture: framebuffer.bin/json produced by this attempt's owned paused diagnostics (started and completed markers for framebuffer-carveouts and framebuffer-pixels), sha distinct from the display/keyboard captures.
criteria.C2_compositor_owns_output: Most of the 2560x1600 output decodes to the desktop colour [56,72,80] within +/-6 per channel (coarse 40 px grid), not the kernel text console.
criteria.C3_client_surface: An 800x480 block of client background [34,47,56] exists on the output.
criteria.C4_fresh_nonce_text: Inside that block, at the client's exact positions, a pixel-for-pixel comparison against masks rendered from the client's own glyph table (ink [235,242,245], background [34,47,56]) matches ~100% for 'CHONKSTEP ON M1', 'DARWIN / ARM64 / WAYLAND', 'FRESH HOST NONCE:' and the run's nonce halves nonce[:24] at (24,178) and nonce[24:] at (24,211), scale 3. The nonce must equal this attempt's challenge and DL10 nonce. A wrong nonce scores ~0.6 in the self-test.
criteria.C5_frame_progress: 'FRAME n' at (24,268) decodes to an n consistent with the DL10_CLIENT_FRAME count near the capture time (the client paints on each callback, at about 2 Hz).
criteria.C6_colour_path: The bars at y=324 decode in order as red [230,60,50], green [40,220,70] and blue [45,100,245] within tolerance. This proves the 2101010 packing; swapped or garbled channels fail.
criteria.C7_compositor_chrome: Pixels immediately above and around the client block are not desktop colour; they show Chonkstep's server-side NeXTSTEP-classic title bar and bevel, i.e. composition by Chonkstep rather than a raw client blit. Judged by inspecting the decoded PNG; the exact theme geometry is not asserted.

tools: scratch-only qualify_frame.py (self-tested on synthetic 30-bit frames: text 1.0/1.0, bars correct, wrong nonce ~0.6, FRAME 137 read exactly) and check_desktop.py (host, console, TX, markers, diagnostics, HV counts, PNG via the repo decoder).
never_claimed_from_this_alone: physical panel scanout (needs a person's observation)
